paper.title: Mixture Proportion Estimation and PU Learning: A Modern Approach
paper.unweighted_loss_location: printed page 8, paragraph explicitly explaining why TEDn does not reweight losses by estimated alpha
paper.sequence: split P/U into train/holdout; warm-start PvU; each round BBE on holdout before ranking/discarding train U and one unweighted training epoch
paper.stopping: training error on P and current retained U until convergence; paper does not prescribe numeric tolerance/patience
paper.target: alpha_U from original marginal U, not a generic OS population pi

source_differences.location: paper Algorithm 3 line 7 and printed page 8; algorithm.py:145,233-236
source_differences.source_value: half the sum of the two CE role means; unlike CVIR paper Algorithm 2, no alpha weighting
source_differences.toolbox_value: paper Algorithm 3 unweighted sum of two BCE role means, single positive-oriented logit
source_differences.decision: do not reuse fixed-alpha CVIR's weighted objective; half/sum scaling and two/one-logit parameterization prevent exact source-replay claims

source_differences.source_value: warm-start estimates after every warm epoch and after each discard epoch; next round consumes previous estimate; initial alpha is zero if no warm-start executes
source_differences.toolbox_value: only after warm-start, then before each round's rank/update, including warm_start_epochs=0
source_differences.decision: paper Algorithm 3 ordering; do not reuse a fixed alpha or consume an uninitialized zero estimate

source_differences.source_value: partial U-gap candidates and zero-based U count, possible zero fallback
source_differences.toolbox_value: paper Algorithm 1 inclusive empirical tails with complete candidate enumeration
source_differences.decision: reuse independently audited BBE; see bbe_source_review_20261017.json

source_differences.source_value: n_U-int(alpha*n_U) retained; argsort default ties; diagnostic divides by discarded count (zero possible)
source_differences.toolbox_value: n_U-floor(alpha_U*n_U), stable ties; alpha_U=0 keeps all, alpha_U=1 raises before a TEDn update
source_differences.decision: source-compatible count rounding, explicit empty-role failure rather than clipping, forced retention or silent warm-start-only success

source_differences.source_value: zip original P/U loaders, filter retained rows within original U minibatch, skip empty minibatches, concatenate P/N for forward
source_differences.toolbox_value: shuffle actual train P and retained U into role batches, cycle shorter batch list to cover longer role, concatenate P/N for forward
source_differences.decision: bounded engineering adapter; not equivalent BN populations or per-row visitation to the source zip/mask recipe

source_differences.source_value: dataset-specific validation loaders, clean-target accuracy/rejection diagnostics and extra MPE estimators
source_differences.toolbox_value: internal observed-role holdout, no clean U targets, external selection data or extra estimator diagnostics
source_differences.decision: follow paper internal split; no original test/validation partition or clean labels repurposed for training

source_differences.source_value: SGD defaults lr0.1/momentum0.9/wd0.0005, optional Adam, source data-specific networks, fixed CLI epoch budget
source_differences.toolbox_value: MLP64 or cloned injected encoder plus MLP head, Adam lr0.001, warm5+at_most20 rounds; absolute train-error change <=1e-4 for 5 consecutive changes
source_differences.decision: explicit finite engineering convergence criterion and hard cap, no approved formal budget or original image/text recipe replay

implementation.input_sampling: explicit ts required; declared design remains caller-unverified
implementation.bb_estimates: new estimate before every TEDn update, from shared internal P/U holdout only
implementation.holdout_split: within observed roles random permutation, ceil(fraction*n_role), nonempty train and holdout
implementation.preprocessing: no fitted input preprocessor added; caller owns external preprocessing provenance
implementation.endpoint_policy: zero keeps all U; one fails loud and invalidates fit; no clipping/one-row fallback
implementation.optimizer_accounting: optimizer_steps_ includes all warm-start and TEDn steps; per-epoch context and pre-update BBE receipt
implementation.memory_policy: full input remains CPU; train concatenated forward <=2*batch_size, eval <=batch_size; only selected-bin receipt retained per round
implementation.snapshot: inference weights only, no optimizer/RNG resume
implementation.holdout_adaptive_reuse: repeated alpha feedback does not certify sequential confidence intervals

engineering_acceptance.scope: CPU synthetic source/temporal/isolation contracts, not formal numerical reproduction
